cases.description: Hysteresis evidence should rank metastable vortex-memory style baths first and recommend field-loop discrimination.

evaluation_notes: Strong hysteresis in 1/Qi versus Bcool persists across cooldowns.
Repeat ZFC and FC loops show a reproducible hysteresis index.

expected.minimal_discriminant_measurement: Repeat ZFC vs FC and up/down field loops; compute hysteresis index; replicate across cooldowns.

cases.description: Smooth power dependence with TLS saturation should classify as TLS ensemble.

input_candidate.primary_observable: Smooth power dependence consistent with saturation.
evaluation_notes: Qi vs readout power follows a TLS saturation trend.

expected.minimal_discriminant_measurement: Run a Qi versus readout power sweep, fit a TLS saturation form, and repeat at two to three temperatures.

cases.description: Non-exponential decay and revivals should map to a structured-memory family.

evaluation_notes: The decay is non-exponential with partial recovery and revivals at late time.
This looks like kernel memory from a structured bath.

expected.minimal_discriminant_measurement: Run time-domain sequences that expose revivals and compare with and without phononic or packaging changes.

cases.description: Avoided crossings should prioritize a coherent parasitic mode path.

evaluation_notes: Spectroscopy shows an avoided crossing with clear mode tracking and a visible gap 2g.

expected.minimal_discriminant_measurement: Run high-resolution spectroscopy versus flux or bias and verify the anticrossing gap and mode tracking.

cases.description: Cross-device correlated bursts should rank a global bath path ahead of local alternatives.

evaluation_notes: Sudden T1 collapses occur together with correlated events across devices during simultaneous monitoring.

expected.minimal_discriminant_measurement: Run fast repeated T1 sampling, look for cross-device correlations, and vary shielding, biasing, and thermalization.
